owner: Rico owner with the acting CTO/session

metrics.name: Roadmap commitments closed with exact-head evidence
metrics.source: GitHub PRs, CI, deployment and production-smoke evidence
metrics.blocker: The repository records exact-head evidence, but the required main-branch ruleset is not yet connector-verifiable or activated.
metrics.next_action: Activate and verify issue #1448 after PR #1449 is independently reviewed and merged.

metrics.name: Trust-critical production journeys passing
metrics.source: Dispatch-only production smoke workflows and exact deployed SHA
metrics.blocker: Journey coverage exists by slice, but there is no single computed numerator and denominator across all trust-critical journeys.
metrics.next_action: Define the canonical journey inventory and emit one aggregate pass-rate report without weakening per-journey evidence.

metrics.name: Activation rate
metrics.blocker: Activation is defined as completing one verified career action, but the full activation funnel is not wired into analytics.
metrics.next_action: Wire signup, CV confirmation, target selection, verified matches and first approved action with privacy-safe idempotent events.

metrics.name: Median time to first verified opportunity
metrics.blocker: The start and verified-opportunity timestamps are not both emitted under one actor lifecycle.
metrics.next_action: Instrument session or signup start and the first verified result presentation with a stable privacy-safe actor.

metrics.name: Verified career actions completed per weekly active user
metrics.blocker: Only search_performed and a limited job_action enum are wired; prepared applications, approved documents, follow-ups and interview preparation are absent.
metrics.next_action: Approve one canonical verified-career-action taxonomy, wire each successful server-side completion and compute weekly distinct actors.

metrics.name: Searches producing at least one verified user action
metrics.blocker: Search and job-action events exist, but they lack a shared search or recommendation correlation identifier.
metrics.next_action: Add a non-user, non-query correlation token so actions can be attributed to the search that produced them.

metrics.name: Applications prepared, approved and submitted
metrics.blocker: Application lifecycle states exist in product data, but no canonical weekly outcome query or approved analytics taxonomy is recorded here.
metrics.next_action: Define state-transition events and reconcile them against the authoritative application table before reporting.

metrics.name: Recruiter replies, interviews, offers and hires
metrics.blocker: Outcome states are not captured with a complete, user-correctable and deduplicated reporting contract.
metrics.next_action: Add explicit user-confirmed outcome transitions and preserve unknown separately from zero.

metrics.name: Seven-day activated-user retention
metrics.blocker: Session-start and activation events are reserved in the allowlist but not fully wired, so an activated cohort cannot be reconstructed honestly.
metrics.next_action: Wire privacy-safe session and activation events, then publish cohort SQL with explicit timezone and dedupe rules.

metrics.name: False execution-claim rate
metrics.source: operation audit records and evaluation cases
metrics.blocker: Individual regressions are tested, but there is no aggregate denominator binding assistant execution claims to operation results.
metrics.next_action: Create an evaluation set that pairs each execution claim with its operation result and report unsupported claims separately.

metrics.name: Paid conversion from activated users
metrics.blocker: An honest activated cohort is not yet measurable and billing attribution must be reconciled atomically before conversion is reported.
metrics.next_action: Complete activation instrumentation and join it to authoritative successful checkout attribution.

metrics.name: AI cost per paying customer
metrics.blocker: Provider cost is not yet allocated to a privacy-safe paying-customer cohort under one reconciled reporting contract.
metrics.next_action: Record model, task class, token or unit cost and plan attribution without storing prompt text.
